howToFill: Paste each team's Showdown export into teams[].showdown, give it a title and a one-line note, then run: node tools/build-campaign.mjs giuseppe-md . Check it is publication-ready with: node tools/build-campaign.mjs giuseppe-md --ready . championsbattledata.com/giuseppe redirects straight into the Team Builder (_redirects) and builder/campaign-teams.js reads this file there. The tool fills in each team's members, and that list is the proof every paste resolved.
